name: harmony
description: Harmony: one calm place to run a home or an office.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @harmony/server" "npm run dev -w @harmony/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @harmony/web && npm run build -w @harmony/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
